config.name: phase8-beir-predictor-feasibility-v1
config.status: freeze predictions and source before collecting holdout timing
config.hypothesis: A 512+512-score sketch and depth-4 decision tree chooses a faster exact NPU method than an N/K-only shape rule on BEIR holdout queries.
config.primary_metric: session-clustered geometric mean of shape-rule latency divided by tree-choice latency; chosen method measurements paired within query, K and session
config.primary_scope: zero-overhead necessary-condition test; any apparent benefit must later survive measured decision overhead
config.required_correctness: zero skips; all measured indices equal stable FP16 CPU reference; reported execution device NPU
config.gate: If zero-overhead feasibility fails, do not build an integrated dispatcher or claim predictive benefit.
